problem: Brands find influencer marketing and creator sourcing hard to manage.
business_model: Influencer marketplace, take rate or fees (not confirmed)

founders.name: Drake Rehfeld
founders.background_notes: YC page. A profile says he later joined NTWRK as director of product, unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: A marketplace web product with no sourced technical hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Influencer marketplaces were crowded and easy to copy; no moat evidence found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Larger influencer platforms were growing in 2018; Demeanor became part of NTWRK, a video commerce company, reportedly in 2019.

market_need_then: Influencer marketing spend was growing and brands mostly searched social sites directly (CIOReview 2018), though no Demeanor-specific demand evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; the company began as the Splish looping video app, which TechCrunch covered.

pivots.from: Splish, an app for sharing looping videos
pivots.why: Not stated in opened sources; Dealroom (AI-generated) says focus moved to creator economy.

outcome_analysis: Demeanor.co began as the looping-video app Splish, pivoted toward an influencer marketplace and became part of NTWRK according to the YC page. The deal terms and date are not public and no funding beyond YC's standard investment was verified, so the reasons behind the outcome are unknown and the pivot_failed label is a tentative inference.
notes: Fetch of thentwrk.com returned HTTP 423 and the site was not worked around. Acquisition year 2019 appears only in an AI-labelled Dealroom page and a profile, so date left null. CB Insights shows 150K convertible note from YC (Jan 2018) and a separate 120K, unverified aggregator entries. The Splish pivot link comes from Dealroom (AI-made) and a TechCrunch article on Splish; the connection is unconfirmed. No dated competitor coverage of Demeanor found. Completeness pass: the 150K convertible note rests on CB Insights alone (Startupintros says 120K); not summed. No press source. Jackson Berry is named as a founder by Dealroom (flagged AI-labelled) and Startupintros only, so he was not added.
